stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: How many seats on each boat?

stations.title: The old program
stations.text: One set of numbers for one boat

stations.title: Your classes
stations.gap: No way to say what a boat is

captions: Lanternquay has a second boat. Bridie wants the seats free on each of them.
The old program keeps numbers for one boat, and a second boat would mix them up.
You write classes for a boat, a ticket and a crossing, and make objects of them.
Now each boat keeps its own seats and people, and an empty crossing says so.
Classes, objects, new and null. Part 3 starts: the program knows what things are.
